edges.sentence: On 2026-10-03, The Hill reported “Paxton trailed Talarico by 2 points in a September Fox News poll.”; on 2026-10-01, Fox News reported “All this gives Talarico a slim 2-point edge over Paxton (51-49%) in the first Fox News Poll among Texas likely voters (so no comparisons are available).”.

On 2026-10-01, Fox News reported “The three-time incumbent has a 52%-47% advantage over the Texas state House representative.”; on 2026-10-02, The Hill reported “Fox News also polled the race for Texas governor between incumbent Greg Abbott (R) and state Rep. Gina Hinojosa (D). Abbott leads Hinojosa 52 percent to 47 percent with a 52 percent approval rating for the sitting governor.”.

On 2026-10-03, The Hill reported “The poll found an even wider gap in likely voters’ favorability ratings of the two candidates, with Talarico earning an 8-point net positive rating, while Paxton came in at 18 points underwater.”; on 2026-10-01, Fox News reported “Talarico enjoys a net positive personal rating of 8 points (52% favorable vs. 44% unfavorable), while Paxton’s is underwater by 18 points (40% vs. 58%).”.

new_slots.name: Senate poll lead
new_slots.sentence: Paxton trailed Talarico by 2 points in a September Fox News poll.

new_slots.name: personal rating
new_slots.sentence: The poll found an even wider gap in likely voters’ favorability ratings of the two candidates, with Talarico earning an 8-point net positive rating, while Paxton came in at 18 points underwater.

new_slots.name: Abbott crossover support
new_slots.sentence: The poll found 10 percent of Talarico supporters are backing Abbott for reelection.

new_slots.name: Republican unfavorability of Paxton
new_slots.sentence: Republicans are six times more likely to view Paxton unfavorably (32%) than Democrats do Talarico (5%).

new_slots.name: Democratic Senate preference
new_slots.sentence: Overall, Texas likely voters split on control of the Senate: 49% prefer a Democratic Senate while 50% favor a Republican upper chamber.

new_slots.name: registered voter lead
new_slots.sentence: Among the larger sample of registered voters, Talarico’s advantage widens to 7 points (just outside the margin of error). That’s up from a 3-point edge in July.

new_slots.name: Cornyn voters for Talarico
new_slots.sentence: The crossover echoes lingering divisions from the competitive GOP primary and runoff: 20% of likely voters who backed Republican incumbent Sen. John Cornyn in the March primary back Talarico.

new_slots.name: DSA Democrat Talarico support
new_slots.sentence: Fully 100% of DSA Democrats and 98% of non-DSA Democrats back Talarico, and slightly more of his backers are certain of their support (89%) than Paxton backers (85%).
